text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 29, 2025) for 2 Clarendon Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 28, 2025) for 2 Clarendon Avenue, Folder Number: 25 231459 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to December 31, 2027.
